sections.heading: Who should buy and who should skip
paragraphs: Buy a chicken-breast-focused air fryer if you cook boneless breasts weekly for weeknights or meal prep and want even browning without a skillet.
Skip oversized dual-basket or grill combos if you only cook one or two breasts at a time and counter space is limited.
bullets: Meal prep batches → 8 qt Hi-Fry / XL baskets

sections.heading: What matters for air fryer chicken breast
paragraphs: Chicken breast needs even heat and space. Overlapping pieces cook unevenly; crowding traps steam and softens the exterior.
High max temps help browning at the end, but doneness still depends on thickness — use a thermometer, not presets alone.
bullets: Arrange in one layer when possible
Pat dry and season lightly before cooking
Rest briefly after cooking for juicier slices

faqs.question: What size air fryer is best for chicken breast?
faqs.answer: A 5–6 qt basket usually fits about 3–5 average breasts in one layer. Choose 8 qt or dual-basket models for meal prep or cooking sides at the same time.

faqs.question: How do I keep air fryer chicken breast juicy?
faqs.answer: Do not overcrowd, avoid overcooking, and check internal temperature with a thermometer. Slightly thicker pieces benefit from a short rest after cooking.

faqs.question: Do I need a probe or grill function?
faqs.answer: A probe (built-in or separate) is the most reliable way to hit doneness. Grill modes can help browning but are optional for everyday chicken breast.

faqs.question: Can I meal prep chicken breast in an air fryer?
faqs.answer: Yes — pick a larger basket or dual-zone model so you can cook more pieces without stacking. Cool, store, and reheat safely.
